leadText: A Butler (Japanese: しつじ Butler) is a type of Pokémon Trainer introduced in Generation VI. They are depicted as well-dressed men employed as servants to other people. They appear to be the male counterpart of s. The only Butler outside of the Battle Maison who can be battled is Chalmers, who appears during Chapter 5 of the Looker Bureau. Butlers also appear in the Battle Chateau, though named as a , , , , or .

===Pokémon the Series===
==== ====
A Butler named Turner appeared in Breaking Titles at the Chateau!, alongside a . They acted as and 's guides through the Battle Chateau, and officiated the matches held in the facility. He has the same character design as that of the Butlers in .

===Pokémon Generations===
The ghost of a Butler appeared in The Old Chateau, where he invited Cheryl to stay for the night at the Old Chateau. After treating her to a "meal", he escorted her to her room before sinking into the floor.
